def transform(M, T):
    # T: 0..7 -> identity, rot90, rot180, rot270, mirrorH, mirrorV, transpose, antitranspose
    n=3
    R=[[M[r][c] for c in range(n)] for r in range(n)]
    if T==0: X=R
    elif T==1: X=[[R[n-1-c][r] for c in range(n)] for r in range(n)]
    elif T==2: X=[[R[n-1-r][n-1-c] for c in range(n)] for r in range(n)]
    elif T==3: X=[[R[c][n-1-r] for c in range(n)] for r in range(n)]
    elif T==4: X=[[R[r][n-1-c] for c in range(n)] for r in range(n)]
    elif T==5: X=[[R[n-1-r][c] for c in range(n)] for r in range(n)]
    elif T==6: X=[[R[c][r] for c in range(n)] for r in range(n)]
    else: X=[[R[n-1-c][n-1-r] for c in range(n)] for r in range(n)]
    return X
names=['id','rot90','rot180','rot270','mirH','mirV','transp','anti']
found=[]
for T in range(8):
    for pol in (0,1):
        tgt={}; ok=True
        for (R,C),M in L.items():
            X=transform(M,T); dot=M[1][1]; other='R' if dot=='O' else 'O'
            for i in range(3):
                for j in range(3):
                    if i==1 and j==1: continue
                    s=X[i][j]
                    col = dot if (s=='W') ^ bool(pol) else other
                    key=(R-1+i, C-1+j)
                    if key in tgt and tgt[key]!=col: ok=False
                    tgt[key]=col
        if ok:
            missing=[c for c in cells if c not in tgt]
            found.append((names[T],pol,tgt,missing))
            print('CONSISTENT', names[T], 'pol',pol, 'uncovered', missing)
print('num consistent hypotheses', len(found))
for nm,pol,tgt,miss in found:
